follow-up time: The study duration is not mentioned, but outcomes were measured postpartum.
outcome: Adverse pregnancy outcomes (placenta previa, cesarean section, hyperamniotic fluid, fetal distress, postpartum hemorrhage)
finding: The combination of IKAP health education and cluster-based care was more effective than cluster-based care alone in improving blood pressure control, reducing adverse pregnancy outcomes, and enhancing postpartum quality of life in women with pregnancy-induced hypertension.
